themes.inflation_too_high: Inflation is above target or too high for comfort.
themes.inflation_persistence: Inflation is proving persistent or slow to return to target.
themes.need_for_further_tightening: Language pointing to additional policy tightening.
themes.higher_for_longer: Restrictive rates may need to stay in place longer.
themes.restrictive_stance: Current or desired restrictive policy stance.
themes.hawkish_hold: Hold decisions framed with a hawkish bias.
themes.labour_market_strength: Strong labour/labor market or employment conditions.
themes.financial_conditions_too_loose: Financial conditions may be insufficiently restrictive.
themes.data_dependence: Neutral/process language about data dependence and optionality.
themes.balanced_risks: Risks described as balanced or two-sided.
themes.inflation_progress: Inflation moving toward target or improving.
themes.disinflation: Disinflationary process and easing price pressures.
themes.policy_transmission_working: Policy tightening is passing through to the economy.
themes.easing_cut_bias: Language pointing toward easing or rate cuts.
themes.recession_slack_risk: Recession, slack, excess supply, or material spare capacity risks.
